title: AID Test Portfolio Audit — Project Config
$comment: producer: PM (hand-edited) or /aid-init copy-if-absent, consumers: [aid-test-audit-config.sh load_test_audit_config, aid-test-audit-dispatch.sh, aid-test-audit-command-allowlist.sh]
description: Project-level audit config contract (.aid-o/config/test-audit.yaml). budget_minutes_default/max_read_only_audit_agents/allowed_runners are read by THIS (P066) plan. (P078 removed the P069 scheduler/resource_locks reservation with the parallelism machinery.)

max_read_only_audit_agents.description: Wholly distinct from dispatch.max_parallel (defaults/orchestration.yaml, the agent-dispatch ceiling) — that key is neither read nor written by this schema/loader.

decision.description: P072 decision-quality audit tuning. Every key is read by exactly one named step; absent keys fall back to aid-test-audit-config.sh's hardcoded defaults, which are byte-identical to the shipped test-audit.yaml.

max_unresolved_fraction.description: Above this fraction of units left unresolved, a full audit is `incomplete` rather than remediation-ready.

profile_trigger_ms.description: A measured run unit at or above this wall time owes a cost profile. The selector is deterministic so that whether a slow suite gets diagnosed is a policy, not a controller's discretion.

profile_max_units.description: Ceiling on units profiled per audit. Units over the trigger but past the ceiling are reported as deferred WITH their measured cost, never dropped silently.

provenance_recheck_budget_ms.description: Budget for the catalog provenance recheck (carry-forward staleness); units not reached in time fail closed to `unknown`.
